examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A collection shown as cards: the `header` slot names each card and the default slot lays out its fields. Four columns in a wide container, then three, two and one as it narrows (container queries, not the viewport).

examples.name: Selectable
examples.summary: Bound to `useCollection` with multi selection: each card gets a checkbox named by its header, a visible Select all items sits above the cards, and the selection survives paging (the same item and selection model as Table).
